reason: I'll fill the methane tank first; both tanks need filling, and either appears to be a reasonable starting point.
expectation: I expect the plant to transfer liquid methane to the ascent tank, though the result may include additional checks.

alternatives.reason: I could fill the oxygen tank first, but neither order is indicated as preferable.

effect: The methane transfer filled the fuel tank, leaving oxygen to load.
reaction: The rising level indicator makes the return feel closer.
reason: The oxygen tank also needs filling, and this is the only gameplay action offered.
expectation: I expect liquid oxygen to transfer through its separate line into the ascent oxygen tank.

effect: The oxygen tank is filled separately, completing the ascent-tank goal.
reaction: The separate oxygen-clean line makes the transfer feel physically considered, though it was an expected result.

mostWorthwhile.text: Filling the methane tank felt most worthwhile: its rising level made the return feel tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling the oxygen tank was straightforward and predictable, with no other gameplay action offered.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; both transfers worked as expected.

arbitrary.text: Neither transfer felt arbitrary, though the choice of which tank to fill first had no clear preferred order.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the return and the discovery unfold, although this chapter's two transfers offered little decision-making.
